description: Read the checks of one conformance run on this account that failed, could not be graded or carried a warning. Quotes recorded OCPI clauses and identifies rules without one. Answers: why did this run fail, and what does the spec say.

after.description: Cursor from a previous call. Omit to start at the first check.

outcome.description: Only checks with this outcome. Omit for failed, unobservable and warned.

reportId.description: The report id, as returned by chargerdojo_list_runs.

name: chargerdojo_get_run_checks
title: Conformance check evidence
